browser_image_artifacts_ready_fields_che.name: browser_image_artifacts_ready_fields_check
browser_image_artifacts_ready_fields_che.value: "browser_image_artifacts"."status" = 'pending' OR ("browser_image_artifacts"."filename" IS NOT NULL AND "browser_image_artifacts"."media_type" IS NOT NULL AND "browser_image_artifacts"."byte_size" > 0 AND "browser_image_artifacts"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL)

channel_auth_challenge_purpose_check.name: channel_auth_challenge_purpose_check
channel_auth_challenge_purpose_check.value: ("channel_auth_challenge"."purpose" = 'login' AND "channel_auth_challenge"."target_user_id" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."requesting_session_id" IS NULL) OR ("channel_auth_challenge"."purpose" = 'link' AND "channel_auth_challenge"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."requesting_session_id" IS NOT NULL)

channel_auth_challenge_confirmation_chec.name: channel_auth_challenge_confirmation_check
channel_auth_challenge_confirmation_chec.value: ("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_sender_id" IS NULL) OR ("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_sender_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_sender_id")) > 0)

channel_auth_challenge_consumption_check.name: channel_auth_challenge_consumption_check
channel_auth_challenge_consumption_check.value: "channel_auth_challenge"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR ("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."identity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

channel_auth_prompt_ciphertext_check.name: channel_auth_prompt_ciphertext_check
channel_auth_prompt_ciphertext_check.value: ("channel_auth_prompt"."status" IN ('queued', 'dispatching') AND "channel_auth_prompt"."token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND length("channel_auth_prompt"."token_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 8192) OR ("channel_auth_prompt"."status" IN ('sent', 'uncertain', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND "channel_auth_prompt"."token_ciphertext" IS NULL)

channel_auth_prompt_lease_check.name: channel_auth_prompt_lease_check
channel_auth_prompt_lease_check.value: ("channel_auth_prompt"."status" = 'dispatching' AND "channel_auth_prompt"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_prompt"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("channel_auth_prompt"."status" <> 'dispatching' AND "channel_auth_prompt"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_prompt"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

channel_auth_prompt_sent_check.name: channel_auth_prompt_sent_check
channel_auth_prompt_sent_check.value: "channel_auth_prompt"."status" <> 'sent' OR ("channel_auth_prompt"."provider_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_prompt"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL)

channel_inbox_lease_check.name: channel_inbox_lease_check
channel_inbox_lease_check.value: "channel_inbox"."status" <> 'dispatching' OR ("channel_inbox"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_inbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

channel_inbox_accepted_check.name: channel_inbox_accepted_check
channel_inbox_accepted_check.value: "channel_inbox"."status" <> 'accepted' OR ("channel_inbox"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_inbox"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

channel_outbox_lease_check.name: channel_outbox_lease_check
channel_outbox_lease_check.value: "channel_outbox"."status" <> 'dispatching' OR ("channel_outbox"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

channel_outbox_sent_check.name: channel_outbox_sent_check
channel_outbox_sent_check.value: "channel_outbox"."status" <> 'sent' OR ("channel_outbox"."provider_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_outbox"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL)
